prompt: Award-winning luxury fashion campaign photography for Monavi Collection ("Wear Your Story"). Joyful royal Indian family standing together celebrating: handsome father in tailored kurta, elegant mother in festive saree, and happy young child in miniature ethnic wear. Warm authentic smiles, wearing coordinated royal wedding attire from Monavi Collection: father in tailored antique ivory and gold sherwani with churidar, mother in a stunning deep crimson Banarasi silk saree with ornate gold zari borders and sheer veil, and young child in a delightful miniature festive gold-trimmed kurta pajama. Harmonious luxury palette, natural fabric draping, authentic textures. Setting: Regal Indian heritage haveli courtyard with carved sandstone pillars and warm festive lantern glow. Lighting: Cinematic warm amber golden hour lighting, rich specular highlights on silks and zari. Camera: Shot on Hasselblad H6D-100c medium format, 85mm f/1.4 lens, shallow depth of field, authentic filmic color rendition. Skin & Anatomy: Natural human skin pores, fine skin texture, anatomically perfect hands and fingers, realistic fabric texture, ultra-high resolution 8k. Composition rule: Royal family group is positioned elegantly in the right 55-60% of the frame standing together in a sunlit palace courtyard. The left 40-45% has clean architectural backdrop tones reserved for brand typography. Framing rule: Full-length standing portrait showcasing the complete family group in wedding ensembles from head to feet in a continuous sunlit palace haveli courtyard setting. Never crop at waist.
